formula.description: dynamic_risk = clamp(base_risk × rain_factor, 0, 1); rain_factor = dry 0.30 / light 0.55 / moderate 0.80 / heavy 1.00 on IMD rain-rate bands (<0.5, 0.5-5, 5-15, >=15 mm/h).  where base_risk = 0.70×static_susc + 0.30×drain_prox_norm. static_susc from script 03 weighted overlay (elevation 0.30, slope 0.20, dist_to_drain 0.25, imperviousness 0.25). drain_prox_norm = 1 - clamp(nearest_drain_m, 0, 500)/500. predicted_depth_cm = dynamic_risk × 30 (illustrative, NOT calibrated). confidence = 0.60 (GIS-only model).
